components.css: .ds-projects{color:var(--nav-text);font-size:var(--type-label);font-family:var(--font-geist-sans),Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;}.ds-projects summary{cursor:pointer;min-height:56px;padding-block:18px}.ds-projects summary:hover,.ds-projects[open] summary{color:var(--accent)}.ds-projects summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:5px}.ds-projects ul{width:300px;max-width:calc(100vw - 40px);max-height:min(420px,65vh);overflow-y:auto;margin:0;padding:7px;list-style:none;border:1px solid var(--accent-line);border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface-raised)}.ds-projects a{display:block;min-height:70px;padding:13px 14px;border-radius:4px;color:var(--foreground);text-decoration:none}.ds-projects a:hover,.ds-projects a[aria-current="page"]{background:var(--accent-soft)}.ds-projects a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:6px;}.ds-projects strong{display:block;color:var(--accent);font-weight:550;line-height:1.6}.ds-projects span{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:var(--muted);font-size:var(--type-meta);line-height:1.6}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-projects{transition:none;animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
This descriptive label records the existing interface rather than proposing a new visual identity. Green accents, quiet surfaces, fine borders, and generous spacing organize software services and project information. The approved extension adds a light palette alongside the established dark palette.

The website follows the browser/system preference automatically. Light values are the CSS default; a dark media query overrides the same semantic properties, including while the page remains open. This is a CSS preference system with no manual theme switch or saved theme state.
keyCharacteristics: Automatic browser preference with consistent semantic roles.
Green actions, restrained borders, and spacious responsive sections.
Shared navigation with page-specific Cove presentation.

rules.name: The Browser Preference Rule
rules.body: Consume semantic CSS properties so surfaces and text respond together to `prefers-color-scheme`; maintain matching `color-scheme` and scheme-specific browser `theme-color` metadata.

rules.name: The Fixed Artifact Rule
rules.body: Keep the actual Cove screenshot and deliberate mint contact panel in their original colors; do not invert imagery or apply a page-wide color filter.

rules.name: The Shared Roles Rule
rules.body: Extend shared tokens in `app/globals.css` for cross-page behavior; keep page composition and component-specific styling in their existing CSS modules.

dos: Do reuse semantic color properties for both browser schemes.
Do preserve keyboard focus, current-page indication, and reduced-motion support.
Do keep the Projects lists driven by the shared project array.
Do retain the Cove screenshot's fictional-demo caption.
donts: Don't apply global image inversion or page-wide color filters.
Don't recolor the fixed mint contact panel when the browser scheme changes.
Don't turn Cove-specific spacing or accent roles into defaults for unrelated pages.
